a.lede: Google's latest update to Gemini brings an AI agent to the Mac that can organize files, fill out forms, and tackle multistep workflows.
a.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you

b.lede: Google's Gemini app for Mac can now use your computer to list items on eBay, speed up creative tasks and fill out forms for you.
b.title: Google boosts Gemini's ability to do 'repetitive tasks' on its Mac app
